subject: Life Skills
title: Deepfakes and Synthetic Media
description: A quick win: understand Deepfakes and Synthetic Media.

hook.text: A deepfake video of a CEO's voice tricked an employee into transferring $243,000 to criminals.

buildup.text: AI can now generate realistic faces, voices, and entire videos of people who never said a word.

discovery.text: Deepfakes use neural networks trained on real footage to generate convincing fake media.

twist.text: Detection tools exist, but they lag behind creation tools. The fakes improve faster than filters.

climax.text: Verify wild claims with original sources. If a video seems shocking, search for the raw footage.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge with deepfake detection?
options: Fakes improve faster than detection tools
Deepfakes only affect video, not audio
